# ankra_services (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's managed services on clusters the token can read, the counterpart of `ankra services list`. Retired services stay listed with state `released` and a `released_at`; filter with `state` to leave them out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_services" "serving" {
  state = "serving"
}

output "serving_services" {
  value = [for service in data.ankra_services.serving.services : service.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) Only services connected to this application's consumers.
- `cluster_id` (String) Only services on this cluster.
- `state` (String) Only services in this state.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `services` (Attributes List) Managed services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster it runs on.
- `cluster_name` (String) Name of the cluster.
- `connected_consumer_ids` (List of String) Consumer bindings it is connected to.
- `created_at` (String) When it was set up.
- `data_boundary` (String) Data boundary.
- `generation` (Number) Generation of the service.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the service.
- `mode` (String) `customer`, `existing` or `hosted`.
- `name` (String) Service name.
- `package_version_id` (String) Package version it was set up from.
- `readiness` (String) Readiness the platform last observed.
- `region` (String) Region.
- `released_at` (String) When it was retired; null while it is live.
- `state` (String) `deploying`, `deployed`, `serving`, `degraded`, `failed`, `retiring`, `released` or `unknown`.
